# Uwi_Dev — Jasa Pembuatan Website & Custom Software | Bandung, Indonesia

> Software built around the way your business works.
> Perangkat lunak yang dibangun seputar cara bisnis Anda bekerja.

Uwi_Dev is a founder-led software engineering studio based in Bandung, Indonesia.
We build custom business systems, websites, web applications, mobile apps, and
system integrations around how your company actually works — not templates.

## Services / Layanan

- [Custom business systems](https://uwidev.com/en#what-we-build) — inventory management, sales tracking, reporting, HR, operations dashboards.
- [Websites & web applications](https://uwidev.com/en#what-we-build) — company profiles, booking systems, portals, custom web apps.
- [Mobile applications](https://uwidev.com/en#what-we-build) — Android and iOS apps for customers, employees, and field teams.
- [System integrations](https://uwidev.com/en#what-we-build) — payment gateway (Midtrans, Xendit), WhatsApp API, ERP, third-party APIs.

## Who we work for / Untuk siapa

- UMKM and growing businesses stuck with spreadsheets and manual processes.
- Restaurants, cafes, retail, logistics, professional services, startups.
- International clients looking for a capable Indonesian development partner.

## Pricing / Harga

- Fixed project pricing — one agreed price before work starts, no hour-counting.
- Quotes based on three things: complexity, timeline, and your company's cashflow.
- Typical well-defined projects: Rp5–10 million. Open to smaller and larger projects.

## Process / Proses

[Discovery](https://uwidev.com/en#how-we-work) → Architecture → Development → Deployment → Ongoing Engineering

## Location / Lokasi

Bandung, West Java, Indonesia. Serving clients across Indonesia and internationally.
